title: Rats Studio
description: Small Mods For The Channel Rats Studios
body:
Welcome to Rats Studio!

This Mod Adds A Variety Of Plushies Based On The Rats Studio Cast Members

This Mod Includes The Following Features
Plushies
Decor
Props
And So Much More
This Mod Allows For Decorating Builds And Adding Some Of Your Favorite Cast Members
To Your Favorite Game



! IMPORTANT !

Feel free to include this mod in modpacks.  
However, do not reupload this mod on any other platform or website.  
You are allowed to upload and share modpacks that include it.

Credits:

Textures: ItzZyphron
Mod: ItzZyphron
